row.evidence: IBM Documentation returns no SCIM results for the QRadar Security Intelligence Platform; QRadar instead creates local users automatically from SAML assertion attributes on sign-in, or reads users and roles from LDAP.
row.notes: New row. Researched as IBM QRadar SIEM (QRadar Security Intelligence Platform 7.6), which IBM sells as on-premises hardware or virtual appliances under EPS/FPM usage or Managed Virtual Server licensing, subscription or perpetual, with no public prices. No SCIM endpoint is documented: an IBM Docs search for SCIM scoped to QRadar returns no results in the product. User lifecycle options are local accounts in User Management (create, edit, disable, delete), LDAP/Active Directory authentication and authorisation (users and roles read from LDAP), RADIUS/TACACS, and SAML 2.0 SSO, which can create local users just-in-time from assertion attributes (role, security profile, tenant). The REST API overview lists no user-management interface (staged_config only retrieves staged user configuration), and QRadar on Cloud users cannot call admin-profile endpoints. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app was found.

plans.name: Enterprise model (Managed Virtual Servers)
plans.notes: On-premises offerings are sold as subscription or perpetual licences; SAML is a product feature, not tied to a licence model.

scim.notes: SCIM 'available: false' is by absence: the docs search scoped to QRadar finds nothing, and the vendor never states SCIM support.

limitations.text: QRadar on Cloud users do not have access to API endpoints that require the admin security profile.

user_api.notes: The public REST API overview lists /api/config (tenants, domains, extensions) and /api/staged_config ('Retrieve staged configuration for users, hosts, ...'); no user create/update/delete endpoints are listed publicly. Full endpoint docs are only on the customer's console at /api_doc/.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (ibm-qradar-tutorial and qradar-tutorial return 404). IBM documents ADFS as a SAML IdP.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory authentication and authorisation (users and roles read from the LDAP server)

citations.title: Configuring SAML authentication - IBM Documentation
